reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Tammy Hall
reviews.text: Ivan and his crew did an incredible job planting and trimming shrubs as well as doing an overall major cleanup of my beds and adding mulch.

reviews.author: Sabrina Reed
reviews.text: We could not be more pleased with their work! We get them yearly for our Spring cleanup and mulch and they do an excellent job. Would highly recommended for any of your landscaping needs.

reviews.author: Lany
reviews.text: This gentleman and his crew came out and did some work on my property. He is the most respectful, well spoken, and intelligent young man I’ve seen in a long time. I will definitely be a long time customer.

reviews.author: Jim Crilley Jr
reviews.text: A great family-owned & run business. Dependable & professional work every time. I’ve used them many times for everything from grass cutting & laying mulch to clearing heavy snow and ice. Fair pricing and excellent service

reviews.author: Alessandra Hutton
reviews.text: Consistent communication and prompt service. Ivan and his team came out and did everything we discussed even when the job required a bit more time and work than originally anticipated. Work was done promptly and without issue. My yard looks great and I would definitely recommend them and plan to use them again in the future.

reviews.author: david halleck
reviews.text: Ivan and his team did a great job cleaning our gutters and removing leaves of the roofs. Showed up early, did a thorough job and cleaned up nicely. The only way you knew he was there was the lack of leaves in the gutters ,roofs and the ground! Ivy landscaping is well worth it!

reviews.author: Marlon Scott
reviews.text: These guys handle all of my needs year-round. They’re very dependable and they do a great job. They’ll keep your property looking great!

reviews.author: Tarrah Godish
reviews.text: We’ve used Ivy Landscaping for a few years now and are always very happy with how it turns out! Ivan is very professional and kind, and I have no idea how his team does such a great job so quickly. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Christy Eliason
reviews.text: Reliable with top notch service! I have been a loyal customer for years and cannot recommend them enough! I tried them out years ago after using several other unreliable landscaping companies that did subpar work. Best decision ever! Reasonably priced, very responsive, and does beautiful work. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: William Waterman
reviews.text: I’ve been using Ivy Landscaping for several years for my spring cleanup, mulching and stone work. They do an excellent job! Quality work, professional attitude, and a fair price. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Dennis Ford
reviews.text: Always great work done well without rushing. We are repeat customers and have referred friends who are also pleased with Ivy Landscaping.

reviews.author: Juans. Life
reviews.text: The crew was punctual! Ivan made sure I was informed every step of the way during the project! This company definitely focuses on the smallest details. Great job!

reviews.author: Gabrielle Sees
reviews.text: Due to the heavy rain/ice storm, my tree snapped in half so I hired Ivan and his team take down two trees along with stump removal. They arrived early as said, cleaned up, laid seed down where the tree was, and will help make sure I get grass to grow. I also use them for my lawn care every other week. Great communication, hard workers, and great lawn services. Proud to say I’ve been a loyal customer for the past 5 years.

reviews.author: Ana P.
reviews.text: Ivan and his team did a wonderful job installing sod on my property. I highly recommend Ivan and his crew for your lawn maintenance needs

reviews.author: Traun Brodhead
reviews.text: I have used Ivy Landscaping LLC for several landscaping projects over the past few years, and they have consistently exceeded my expectations. Their communication is always prompt and professional, making the entire process smooth from start to finish. The quality of their work is outstanding, and they take pride in delivering excellent results while completing projects efficiently. They are reliable, detail-oriented, and always leave the property looking great. On top of that, their pricing is fair and competitive, providing excellent value for the quality of service they deliver. I highly recommend Ivy Landscaping LLC to anyone looking for a professional, dependable landscaping company. I will continue to use them for future projects and would not hesitate to recommend them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Tyler Allen - Williams
reviews.text: Ivan and his crew were very professional. I used him for mulch and some clean up work at my home. He was very responsive and made last minute reservations for me. He answered every question I had and I plan to use him again this year and so on. If I could give him 6 stars I would!

reviews.author: Patricia Sullivan
reviews.text: The back border of our property was a mess of ivy, poison ivy and other brush. Ivan and his crew did a wonderful job clearing it all out. Highly recommend.
